extracted.name: California Farm Grandma Almond Cookies
extracted.description: Great cookies to serve unexpected guests in 16 minutes, or when you want to spoil yourself.
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 400F degrees. Put baking paper on 4 half size baking trays. Mix ingredients till smooth batter. Put 8 teaspoons of cookie batter per tray with 4 almonds per cookie. Slide in oven, bake 8 minutes, pull out. Cool three minutes, serve.
